Reasoning: The stage must keep the panda_fingertip pose fixed while grasping the can. freeze_position holds the current/start-of-stage panda_fingertip origin within 0.01 m. freeze_orientation holds the current/start-of-stage panda_fingertip orientation within 5 degrees, without adding any new +z or +y axis objective. object_grasped is used instead of close_gripper because success requires the can to be physically held, not merely mechanically closed; the gripper_closed condition records the intended closing state metadata. Bilateral finger contact, symmetric finger-joint motion toward 0.0, finger effort thresholds, stable grasp detection from joint/effort feedback, and continuous monitoring of pose/joint/effort signals are required by the task but are not directly parameterizable in the available Constraint API, so they are represented only by object_grasped where possible and otherwise omitted.
